_note: Calgary Insight pronunciation list for Kokoro (studio-probe probe/tts.py). Key = word exactly as written in the script (case-sensitive, whole word). ipa = the exact phonemes Kokoro speaks (preferred; espeak-style IPA with stress marks); say = plain respelling used only if phoneme mode is unavailable (no hyphens or spaces: QC on Nov 17, 2026 showed 'Breez-bwah' is read as two words). Captions keep the script's spelling. Add a word whenever asr_report.json or Hassan flags it; check phonemes.json for how Kokoro says it by default.

Bow.why: Bow River / The Bow rhymes with 'go', not 'cow'

Macleod.why: Macleod Trail, Fort Macleod, Colonel James Macleod

Brisebois.why: Inspector Ephrem Brisebois, Brisebois Drive (French name)

Éphrem.why: French first name of Inspector Brisebois; uses Kokoro's own reading of 'Éphrem' (QC Nov 17: 'ˈeɪfɹɛm' heard as 'Afram', 'eɪfɹˈɛm' ran into Brisebois)

Ephrem.why: French first name of Inspector Brisebois; uses Kokoro's own reading of 'Éphrem' (QC Nov 17: 'ˈeɪfɹɛm' heard as 'Afram', 'eɪfɹˈɛm' ran into Brisebois)

TELUS.why: TELUS Sky, TELUS Spark: a word, not letters

Rouleauville.why: the French settlement that became Mission

Mohkinstsis.why: Blackfoot name for the Calgary area

Acheson.why: Assistant Commissioner Acheson Irvine; Kokoro said 'Aixson' (QC Nov 17, 2026)

Cochrane.why: Cochrane (town, Cochrane Ranche, Senator Matthew Cochrane): locals say 'COCK-run'; Kokoro said 'cock-rain' (QC Nov 17, 2026)

Daqing.why: Daqing, Calgary's twin city in China; Daqing Avenue/Plaza in Chinatown
